settings.text:
We are living in pivotal times where it's more important than ever that the Magdelane story is truthfully told.

And now in this course, you will have the opportunity to learn from one of the greatest Ascension Teaching researchers and teachers of our time, William Henry.

William Henry is an internationally recognized author and authority on human spiritual potential, transformation, and ascension, and host of “Ascension Keepers” series on Gaia TV. He has devoted over 40 years of research to the Gnostic Mysteries and over 20 years of research on Mary Magdalene and the transformative sacred science of human ascension to support the next level of human consciousness and our expanding reality.

This course is an extension of William Henry's life work, designed to lead you through Mary Magdalene's story, illuminating the paths less traveled and revealing hidden insights that will forever alter your perspective.

The course is an extension of William Henry's life work devoted to the lost light body teachings of the Divine Feminine, beginning with an exploration of the Descent of Inanna and the mystery teachings that have emerged from Her journey through the Underworld.

We then explore the path of Mary, the mother of Christ and the first Christian to ascend, and Mary Magdalene, the consort of Christ and priestess of the ascension mysteries.

This immersion offers a timeline of extraordinary teachings and technologies devoted to the transformation of humans into angels. 

Through years of researching art and gnostic texts, William Henry’s presentations synthesize Egyptian, Tibetan, Essene, Christian, and Cathar ascension and light body teachings that show people how to connect with, and even to become angels…or the highest expressions of ourselves.

No matter what spiritual background you come from, our intention is to synthesize the sacred sciences in a way that is practical, useful, and effective. William is devoted to rediscovering and sharing the sacred teachings for transforming humans into angels and lighting the Path of Souls for all

settings.title: Unlocking the Mysteries of Ascension: Exploring Mary Magdalene's Sacred Path

settings.text:
During this course, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Delve into the mysteries of ascension and the Rainbow Light Body through the resurrection oils she was known to craft in her alabaster jars.
  • Uncover her role as a priestess of the Egyptian Goddess Isis, where she studied ancient recipes for transformative oils.
  • Unveil her unparalleled knowledge of plants, plant medicine, and even entheogenic practices for human transfiguration.
  • Discover the captivating truth about her as the Chief Apostle of Yeshua – what made her a threat to both disciples and Roman Authorities?
  • Explore the unique knowledge passed from Jesus in his resurrection body to Mary Magdalene.
  • Delve into her origins in Magdala, where recent archaeological revelations, like the Magdala Stone, shed new light on her story.

 "In this course, you will join a narrative, a lineage, that was begun thousands of years ago and is coming to fruition in our time." - William Henry

settings.title: 1. MAGDALENE’S VEIL
settings.dropdown_text: Our journey begins with the story of the veil presented to Yeshua by Mary Magdalene on the path to the Cross. We explore the astonishing properties that are inexplicable to modern science.

settings.title: 2. THE MAGDALA STONE AND THE ASCENSION THRONE
settings.dropdown_text: One of the greatest archaeological discoveries of the past 100 years was the discovery of an altar stone in Magdala, the home of Mary Magdalene. As William has uniquely proposed, this stone encodes the secrets of Jewish Merkaba mysticism and reveals the profound knowledge about ascension to which the Magdalen was privy.

settings.title: 3. THE SECRET OF THE SKULL
settings.dropdown_text: The skull is a symbol for the ancient mysteries of resurrection. William traces the origin of this symbolism to Egypt and the Resurrection School of Isis, whose symbol was the head of Osiris. He proposes this is the reason why Mary Magdalene is often painted holding a skull. But that’s just the beginning. Our journey is inward. He takes us to the paintings of Magdalene in ecstasy and pulls the veil back on another astonishing secret of Mary Magdalene. Her use of plant medicine to see(k) the Light of Christ.
settings.dropdown_html:

settings.title: 4. THE NAZARITES OIL AND THE LIGHT BODY
settings.dropdown_text: We dive deep into the Essene teachings about a miraculous Oil of Joy that can heal the mind and body of any disease, and even transmute the human body into light. This transfiguration was the spiritual focus of the Essenes who knew how to produce it from within their neurosecretory system. William presents his remarkable textual and artistic evidence that the apparitions of the Virgin Mary reveal that she attained her ascended light body. So did Mary Magdalene. As ascended beings, both are able to phase between their light body and their flesh and blood form.

settings.title: 5. THE ANGELS AND THE OIL
settings.dropdown_text: Mary Magdalene was the first to see the resurrected Christ. She also was only one of three women, the Myrrophores, who interacted with the angelic beings whose clothes were like lightning in the tomb. These angels are plasma beings. They also appeared to Jesus in the Garden of Gethesemene on the eve of the Crucfixion. One of them delivered an oil that strengthened Jesus and prepared him for what is to come. Was this oil the same as the elixir in Magdalene’s alabaster jar? Connections about.

settings.title: 6. LIFTING THE SERPENT
settings.dropdown_text: The hieroglyph for the head of Osiris, the symbol of the Resurrection School of Isis, is a serpent on a pole. Jesus proclaimed this symbolism contained the secret of eternal life. In this extraordinary chapter we go deeper into the ancient Egyptian mystery school teachings about resurrection. William traces the serpent on a pole symbolism from Egypt to early Christianity to the Cathars of Southern France who claimed they inherited the lost teachings of Yeshua and Mary Magdalene.

This discussion will change how you read all sacred texts as it will show that the secret you seek is truly within. Mary Magdalene is not just pointing you there, she will meet you there.

As a thank you for signing up for this immersion, you will receive: 

William Henry's "The Rainbow Light Body: The Greatest of All Mystical Teachings" Bonus Class

This class is a powerfully illustrated presentation in which William Henry leads you through his development process from ancient Egyptian light body teachings to early Christian to Tibetan Rainbow Light Body teachings.

The ultimate goal of the Rainbow Body practitioner is to accelerate the frequency of the body until it dissolves into five colored rainbow light, leaving behind only hair, toe and fingernails that have no nerves to be transmuted. The result is a new birth or rebirth into a luminous, humanoid body shot with gold and which emits rainbow colors.

This practice has always been reserved for the greatest of gurus and ascended masters. William brings this practice to life with a presentation packed with astounding art and insight available no where else.

In this bonus presentation, you will:
Discover how the ancient cultures of the Israelites, Christians, Essenes, Egyptians, Tibetans and more understood the importance of the Rainbow Light Body.

Understand the mystical pursuits of the Rainbow Light Body and the spiritual practice of using Sacred Art as a conduit to the divine realms. Dramatically shift your consciousness about what his possible for you.
Experience empowerments to feed your light body.

Meet William Henry

William Henry is a Nashville-based author, investigative mythologist, art historian, and TV presenter. He is an internationally recognized authority on human spiritual potential, transformation and ascension.

He has a unique ability to incorporate historical, religious, spiritual, scientific, archaeological and other forms of such knowledge into factually-based theories and conclusions that provide the layperson with a more in-depth understanding of the profound shift we are actually experiencing in our lifetime.

The spiritual voice and Consulting Producer of the global hit History Channel program, Ancient Aliens, and host of the Gaia TV series The Awakened Soul: The Lost Science of Ascension, and Arcanum, along with his wife, Clare, William Henry is your guide into the transformative sacred science of human ascension.

By bringing to life the ancient stories of ascension through art and gnostic texts, he teaches the secrets of soul transfiguration or metamorphosis and connects people to one another across cultures, time and space.

With over 30 years of research distilled into 18 books and numerous video presentations, William’s work will guide you to the next level of human consciousness and our expanding reality.

Along with his wife, Clare, he leads luxury, ascension-themed tours to sacred sites including Egypt, France, Italy, Spain, and England.
